question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru naagyezaho kukoragana n'abeshuri aha kumanya emihingi erikwenda kworeka ebintu ebirikushushana. Kuti ahabw'ekyo, omwegyesa naaha omuguta ogurikutebeekanisiza emihingi y'omuntu, ey'okwoleka, n'ey'obweeru, kandi naagamba kushoma orubungo oruhango orurikukurataho: Okutiina Eky'amazima Kuruga Omukubanza kuhika Aha Gatanu, akaba naagyenda aha gari ya pasi. Akaba naatambura emigarara yoona n'enyegyerero kumara obwire bwingi. Akaba naamanya omurinzi wa sitenseni yoona. Naaza kumara obwire ki naabeshya, bakaba nibamugambira. Ahabwenki atarikugambira omukazi we ngu yaagobwa emyezi mingi enyima. (Paola Rivera). Ku baraamare kushoma, omwegyesa naabuuza abeshuri aha mihingi erikwenda kworeka ebintu omu rubungo. Omusheri naagamba ngu ekigambo "las" nikikwatana n'ekintu kikuru kimwe omu rubungo. Oburemeezi ki eky'okugarukamu kw'omusheri kirikworeka aha kintu eki omwegyesa yaashabire?
answer_a: Enjuranirano aha kutaana kw'emiterere y'amazina g'ekicweka n'ebindi bice by'orugramatika
answer_b: Okumanya ebirimu omuhendo kuraba omu kukwatanisa ekigambo "las" n'ekigambo "stations"
answer_c: Okumanya kukye kw'abantu abakuru abarikukwata aha mugani ogurikukwatwaho: abarinda, we, omukazi we
answer_d: Okumanya ebiteekateeko by'amashuuruuru agari hamwe n'emikoresa yaago erikwihaho.

question:
Omwegi omugurusi owa sekenda ari kukora n'abeshomesa aha kushoma, kucweekereza, n'okushoborora ebyahandiikwa by'enyimba ezirikukwata aha mutwe gw'obugabe. Omu murimo, nibahurira orwimbo "El cautivo de Til Til" bwanyima bagashabwa kucweekereza n'okushoborora omugambi w'enyimbo kurugiirira aha kaceeci akarikukurataho:
Nibagira ngu eiziina rye ni Manuel
kandi nibamutwara omuhanda ogurikugyenda Til Til,
ngu gavana tarikwenda
kureeba omutindo gwe murungi omuhanda La Cañada.
Nibagira ngu omu rutaro akaba
arungiire munonga kandi omu rurembo
akazairika nk'enkuba
y'obugabe.
(...)
Nibagira ngu akaba nk'enkuba
obu yaabaire natembeka embaraasi ye
kandi obu omutembesi yaabaire nagyenda
boona bakamweta eiziina Manuel.
Tindikubaasa kugaruka
kumureeba ari omugabe kandi murungi,
nimanya gye ngu akaseeka omuhanda
ogurikugyenda Til Til.
El cautivo de Til Til, enshoborozi ya Aquelarre.
Aha kucweekereza omurimo, omwegyesi naataana n'eky'okugarukamu ky'omweshomesa ekirikukurataho:
"Omugambi naashusha nk'orikuteekateeka n'okwijuka. Ahabw'okuba ari munaku n'omutima gurikuremera, kwonka ni omugira, nk'enkuba y'obugabe. Okugyeragyeranisa oku okukozirwe omugambi nikushusha nk'okurikushisha munonga ahabw'okuba enkuba n'ekintu ekirikuzairika kandi nikwo n'obugabe buri. Naamanyisa eiziina ry'obureero omuri Chile, kandi omu bwingi, tarikukoresa ebigambo birikumera."
Buzibu ki eky'okugarukamu ky'omweshomesa eki kirikureeta omu kubiikaana n'ekigyendererwa ky'omurimo ogurikushabwa omwegyesi?
answer_a: Nikwooreka kwetabura kukye ahagati y'enshonga erikukwatanisa n'eiraka eririkugambwa omu mutwe.
answer_b: Erihanganisa eky'okugarukamu ekirikutaana n'ekyabaire kirikushabwa omu murimo, ahabw'okuba kirikuta omutima aha bintu ebindi eby'omuriiri.
answer_c: Nikukuratira aha kwesiima kw'omuntu kukira ebiri omu mutwe gw'ebirikweshongorwa kworeka omugambi gw'ogurikugamba
answer_d: Nikwooreka obutabaaho bw'ebirikukwata aha mutwe gw'ekigambo omu kugarukamu, ahabw'okuba nikwooreka geranisizo erikozirwe omukyo, kwonka ti n'emirongo endiijo.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omwaka ogwa kabiri owa siniya atandika okuhandiika ebitabo ebirikushoboorora. Omu bwire bw’omurimo ogu, ariyo nashwijuma ebigambo ebi kuruga omu bitabo ebihandiikirwe abegi be: "Bakoze buri kimwe kubaasa kucweekereza omukka ogurikurekurwa, reero, tibarikukikora" na "Tihariho enkyukye enungi ekozirwe omu muringo ogurikukoresibwa okucweekereza ebintu ebirikubora, kandi obuhereza bw’ensimbi buhikiireho kubaasa kubihikiiriza." Oburemeezi bukuru oburikworekwa omu bitabo ebi abegi barikworeka niki?
answer_a: Obuhangwa bw’okutabaasa kuteeraho ebiri kubangaanisa okugyenda omu maisho omu kuhandiika
answer_b: Oburemeezi bw'oburemeezi omu muringo gwaabo ogutari gumwe omu mikwatane yaabo ey'amanyisho
answer_c: Oburemeezi bw'okumanya omukago gw'amakuru g'ebigambo omu kuzooka ebyahandiikwa
answer_d: Okukoresa kubi enyegataire kutaaho emikago y'okurwanisa aha biteekerezo

question: Omuhanda ogu nigushobora kureetera omwegi kwongyera kukora obushwereke bw'ebirikwetwa omu buhandiiki: "Eky'okureeberaho eki orikukoresa nikikuru, kwonka noobaasa kukikwata aha buhandiiki bw'omuhangi? Okukwata aha buhandiiki nikikuru ahabw'okuba nikireetera abashomi kumanya ahu orikugyenda ebi orikugamba n'okuhwera okwetantara okwiba ebi abandi baahandiika."
answer_a: Ku tori otarikwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe omu bihandiiko byawe, okugamba kwawe tikurikubaasa kwemerera.
answer_b: Ongyerereza omutwe gw'ekicweka orikugira ngu n'obundi bw'oburemeezi kandi okigurize n'ekyahandiikirwe kuruga omu kitabo.
answer_c: Obu omuhanda ogu orikukoresa okuhika aha kitabo, noongyeramu ekyahandiikirwe ekirikukwasisa, ensonga ei orikwenda kugambaho neeba neyorekire gye.
answer_d: Shoma ekitabo ekirikushoborora ebiri omu kuhandiika ebyahandiikirwe abandi n'obwegendereza, reeba n'eby'okureeberaho ebirikworekwa.

question: Omugyezibwa, orikukora aha kubangana n’eklassi y’abanyeshuri ab’omwaka gwa 3 omu sekenda, ashomesa ebi omwe aha banyeshuri be yaahandiika: “Ahabuurizi abakugu bagira ngu, obwahati, tusangwa twine endozo y’emissi y’amafuta erikukirayo omu myaka eshatu ehingwire.” Ni ndy’aha bigambo ebi erikuba eky’okugarukamu ekirikukirayo kurungi kurengyesereza enshobi y’okuhikaana erikwolekyerwa ekigambo “erikukirayo” omu bihandiiko ebyo?
answer_a: Ekyeshomo eki nikireeta okutaikirizana omu rurembo rw'ebigambo "rikuru kurusha byoona"
answer_b: Nihaihi ki ekikuru ekihingire kuruga omu bintu ebi orikubaasa kukora, obwo nooba noogyezaho kukora ebintu ebi orikubaasa kukora ebirungi?
answer_c: Eizi ki ekigambo "ekirikukirayo" kirikukwatana nakyo omu bwingi bw'ebigambo?
answer_d: [No text provided]

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa kindergateni n'akora okusomesa okw'okubanza okwetegyereza oburemeezi bw'abaana, okukuratira obwengye bw'okumanya amagambo, okukiraho obushoboorozi bw'okushoboorora amagambo n'okumanya ekicweka eki barimu. Ni mbeera ki y'eby'oburezi erikukwataana n'okukora ebirikumanyisa aha bushoboorozi obu?
answer_a: Baita abaana kuzoora omuzaano gw'okuhuurana. Emitwarize mikuru y'ebigambo ebirikushaanisa neegambwa, hatarikukoresa by'okureeba. Koresa akatimbe k'okureebamu ebirikukorwa.
answer_b: Yoreka abaana ebintu bingi n'ebiteebo ebirikwimira omutindo ogutali gumwe, otabeete kwetorana ekintu kimwe, bagambe eiziina lyakyo, bakeete omubiteebo ebirikumurikirra omutindo ogurikusaana. Shungura omulimo gwabo okuraba omu rubriki.
answer_c: Hamuura abaana kureeba akameeza k'ebicweka bibiri erikubamu ebika bimwe na kubaha kaadi ezirikubaasa kwegaita n'ekika ekirikugyerera. Koreesa ebyahandiikwa by'ebyabaireho omu kubahandiika oku baakozeseze.
answer_d: Ha abaana empapula ezirimu ebishushani by’ebika bitari bimwe, oobasabe kutoorana ekishushani kimwe barikukishoboorora bataarikugambaho iziina ryakyo. Abo abarikukora nabo bashemereire kugamba aha kigambo eki barikukishoboora hamu n’okugambaho ekika ky’ekigambo eki. Shungura omukozi orikukoresa akapimo k’omurimo.

question: Omugyezya w’omwaka ogw’ina nasoma n’abegi be ekicweka ekirikukurataho kuruga omu mulingo *Okugamba kw’Enkwija,* ekya Alicia Morel:  Simon enkwija akaba aine enjara nyingi munonga. Akaba n’aine omukazi, Clarita, n’eka nkuru y’abaana mushanju, ahabw’okuba bakaba “bazaara bingi.” Omu izooba ly’obutiti eririkumurika, limwe aha ago eizooba ebi orikukwata nk’okuruka n’okuguruka omu misiri n’enshozi, Simon akaita omukazi we kwija n’eka ye kuruga aheeru ahabw’omuyaga murungi. “Clarita, kozesa omugisha gw’obwire oburungi ahabw’okuba nyencakareijo n’eza kwija!” “Oli musiru? Embwa nari omukonongo ogurikugyenda omu kibira ekiri haihi nibaza kwija,” akagarukamu, narugaho akahunga omu mwina. “Mbwa ki nari emikonongo ki! Eizooba rya hati n’eizooba ry’okurekerera.” “Oli mazima?” “Tindi mugumu gwa kwima aha iguru hati eizooba rya hati rikaba litari eizooba eri omuyigyi atarikubaasa kwiga,” Simon akahamya, narugaho akareeba eizooba.  Eki aha bibuuzo ebiri omuhanda nikibaasa omwegyezya kubuuza abegi kwenda kureeba ebi barikubaasa kuteebereza kuruga omu mulingo?
answer_a: Obwire bwa sizani bwali bute obu Simooni yaahamire omukazi we?
answer_b: Oraitu ki oteekateeka aha mitwarize ya Simooni eri ahari Clarita?
answer_c: Ahabwaki Simon akaba ayenda omukazi we kutwara abaana omu izooba eryo?
answer_d: Clarita aragira nguhi ki obu arikugarukamu omushaija we?

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu mwaka ogw’abiri akoreire aha mugani gwa Cinderella n’eklassi yaabo reero yakora okugyezibwa okuhango kw’abeeshuri okwetegyereza. Ekibuuzo kimwe omugyezibwa yaabaziise nikyo: “Ahabwaki banyina Cinderella bakagumiisiriza okugyezaho engaito y’eicupa n’obu etabaabaire neebahika gye?” Kiki ekirikworekwa ekirikukwatwaho ahabw’ekibuuzo eki omugyezibwa yaabaziise?
answer_a: Nibamanya okuteekateeka omu bugufu bw'ebyahandiikwa by'ebirikukwata aha bintu ebirikurwanisibwa.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza emikago y'ebintu ebiretera ebindi kubaho omu bitabo by'ebyeshura.
answer_c: Nibarikira omukururu gw'ebintu ebigambirwe omu bitabo by'ebyeshariziibwa
answer_d: Nibamanyisa emiringo y'abantu abakuru abarikukorera omu bintu ebirikugambwaho omu by'okubaza eby'omutaano.

question: Omwegyesereza ki aha bibuuzo ebi orikukuratira nikikwasisa omwegi kushuuruura ebiri omu mutwe gw'ekigambo kuruga omu bihandiiko ebi turikwega?
answer_a: Ahabw'enki ebishuubi bitarikusangwa omu Antarctica?
answer_b: Ahabati nibiki ebishushani by'empango nibikwataniisibwa n'okuba enyamaishwa nto?
answer_c: Ni nshami ki erikutaana enkwakwa n'enyamaishwa endiijo zoona?
answer_d: Ahabantu tibarikubaasa kuhurira ebirira by'empango ahabw'okuba biriyo nibikora ebirira ebi turikweta "ultrasound," ebi biri ahaiguru y'omuringo gw'ebirira ebi abantu barikubaasa kuhurira.

question: Ni engyenderwaho ki ehihire aha batoorwa b'omu mwaka ogwa kana eky'okukoresa kwegyesa abeeshuri kumanya amakuru aga bikwaso by'ebigambo byongyera aha bigambo ebi birikuhindura?
answer_a: Shoma omubazo ogu: "Omwana omuto akaba ari omugayaarizi kandi atarikworobera. Akaba aine kuhabwa buli kimwe eki arikwenda ahabw'okuba omugabe, ishe, akagira ngu tihaine eki aine kwimwa omwana w'omugabe". Haza ogarukye: Ahabw'enki kirikugambwa ngu omwana omuto akaba ari omugayaarizi kandi atarikworobera?
answer_b: Abasayansi nibarikushoma ebirikubaho aha bizinga by'omutego bikuru bya Antarctica kureeba oku birikubaasa kukwata aha nsi n'okureeta obwire obutahumwire. Baitu ekigambo ekiri omu bworo bw'ahaiguru nikimanyisa ki?
answer_c: Shoma omubairo: "Aurora ya Chile n'ekikuru munonga ahabw'okuba kyakwatsiize omu kukuza ebiragiro by'obwetengye. AbanyaChile baingi, kurabira omu kushoma orupapura rw'amashuuru oru, bakaguma bakakuratira ngu Chile erikwetenga okuva omuri Spain erashobora kubaho". Hanyuma garukamu: AbanyaChile bakaguma bakakuratira ki obu barikushoma orupapura rw'amashuuru rwa Aurora ya Chile?
answer_d: Shoma ya Sande, ekigo ky'enyama ky'e London kyazooka, bwanyima y'omuriro ogwahatiire emirimo kurekererwa. Ekigo ky'enyama ky'e London, ekikuru omu nsi yoona, kyazigurwa omurundi gw'okubanza omu mwaka gwa 1826 kandi kirimu enyama ezikira

question: Omwegyesereza omwegisha owa klasse ya kashatu nashoma omwandiko ogu omuhandiikirwe omwe aha banyeshuri be: "Nshemereirwe munonga omu wiikendi ndeengo. Ngyenda omu myuziyamu ensya ey'ebya sayansi reero ngyenda omu kyehererezi kandi ndeba ekihaha kikuru. Reero ndeba firimu erikukwata aha mibumbe, ngyenda omu duka ngura ekitabo, ngaruka omu ka ngishoma yoona." Ni enki aha bintu ebi erikukwata aha muringo ebigambo birikukoresibwa erishemereire kurengyeserezebwamu omu mwandiko gw'omunyeshuri?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebirungo by'okuhuura hamwe
answer_b: Okukoresa ebigambo "the" na "a/an"
answer_c: Okuhindura ebigambo by'okukora
answer_d: Okurungaanisa orugramma

question: Ni kikuru ki aha bikurikiyo, ekirikukwasa abeeshure b'omu mwaka gwa kabiri kuteeraho kukwatanisa ebigambo omu kuhandiika?
answer_a: Gambaho ekishushani eki sentensi erikugamba. Nk'eky'okureeberaho, sentensi yaagira eti: "Eiroza eine amahwa", gambaho eiroza eririmu amahwa.
answer_b: Gambura no kushuuru ebirango by'abantu kuruga omu kishushani. Nk'eky'okureeberaho, kuruga omu kishushani ky'omushaija omuzaani, yoreka eirangi ry'ebyambaro bye, obushushani oburi omu maisho ge, n'ebindi.
answer_c: Shangwa enshobi omu rurimi rw’omunyamahanga. Nk’eky’okureeberaho, omu sentensi “Embwa yanywa amate”, shangwa enshobi z’omunyamahanga.
answer_d: Omu omwegi ahabwa ebigambo ebi ahabwa, ahabweky'okureeberaho, omwegi atungire akakaati kaine ekigambo "omukaate" yaahangaho sentensi etarikwetegyerwa, nk'eti: "Ninyambara omukaate gwa bururu."

question: Omugyezibwa orikwegyesa abaana abari aha mutendera gw'ahaagati areebire ngu ekibiina kye ky'abahungu n'abashikiro nikishemererwa eby'okuhanga n'okushwijuma nibakoresa engaro zaabo, kandi emirundi mingi nibakopoora enyuguta kuruga omu nteekateeka, magazini, n'obubonero. N'ekyo ahabw'ekyo, aha kutandika kwa semesta ya kabiri, naateekateeka kukora aha bigendererwa by'okwega ebi: - Omusingi gw'Orurimi: "Kureeta obubonero bwabo bw'ebishushani omu mbeera z'okushambaaza." - Omusingi gw'Omubiri n'Okugyeza: "Kuhikiiriza obuhangwa bwabo oburikureeba n'okugyeza kurabira omu kukoresa ebintu bitari bimwe, eby'okushambaaza, n'ebikoreso." Ni bumwe aha bumanyiso bw'okwega oburikukwatanisa ebigendererwa ebirugireho omugyezibwa?
answer_a: Omu kibumbiro ekikuru, koramu okushoma kw'ebyeshongo okurikugabana; bwanyima abaana bakope emwe aha bigambo nibahanga obutumwa bwabo bw'omutaano.
answer_b: Omu twegaita omu tubundu tukye, abaana nibatoonwa kwema ebigambo omu magazini hamu n'empapura z'amahuura, reero bakopiisa ebimu ahari byo nibahanga ebyahandiikwa bisya.
answer_c: Omu twine omutindo gw'abaana bato, nibatoonwa kwandika omugati hamwe, hanyuma bateeke nibakozesa ebijiko, enfuko, n'ebibya kukora omugati ogwo.
answer_d: Omu kubumbiro rikuru, yombeka okushoma eky'omugani omu iraka rikuru reero oite abaana kweshushaniiriza ekishushani ky'aha rubaju rundi ebintu ebirikuruga omu mugani hambukireho nibakopiinga amariina g'abantu abarikukora omu mugani ogwo.

question: Omu kwiiteeka ry’abaana abarikukura omu by’okwegyesa, abakozi nibacuraana kutebeekanisa engyenderwaho z’okukuzamu ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekikuru eky’Orurimi: “Okugamba omu kanwa ebi barikwenda n’ebirikubashemeza, kuraba omu kwegaita kw’ebigambo n’enyegyesa, okukoresa ebigambo-ebiteeko n’aha butoosha okukoresa sentensi nce.” Ni muringo ki gw’emikoreso ogurikukwataana n’abaana kugira ngu bagyendereere ekigyendererwa ky’okwega eki?
answer_a: Omu ruziga rw'okubanza, shaba abaana kugarukamu ebigambo kuruga omu rweshongoro. Bwanyima, omu kumanyisa kusya, bareke bakuratire enyeshongoro n'okugarukamu omubiri n'ebigambo. Bahweereza nibaririmba nibaherekerwa ebintu by'okukomaho.
answer_b: Omu tukambi twabana, mushabe abaana kushuuruura n'okwiita ebishushani by'ebinyama ebitaari bimwe. Bwanyima, omu muringo omusya, mubashabe kwiita enyembo ezirikukwata aha binyama. Bahweerezeho kujuza sentensi nyamuhanga n'enyembo ezirikukwata aha binyama.
answer_c: Omu kibinja kinene, yeta abaana kucweera omubisi gw'ebibala kandi obahiga kushuuruura ebiri omunda yagwo kuraba omu bigambo by'okubahiga. Hanyuma, omu kumanya kusya, obete kuronda kuraba omu kubetaanga ebibala ebi barikwenda kukoresa kutebeekanisa omubisi musya gw'okucweera.
answer_d: Omu kubashoma omugani, buuza abaana omuntu ou bakunda munonga omu mugani ogwo. Hanyuma, omu kukora ekintu ekihyaka, bareke barange ekikokoto ky'omuntu ou bakunda munonga, kandi obashabe bakyoreke abanywani baabo omu kelasse. Muherize obahiga kukoresa ekikokoto omu kuzooka emigani omu bwesigye.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa puriiskuuru arimu kutebeekanisa kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikuruga omu Mutima gw'Orurimi orwa Verbal: "Okworeka omuntu omumwa omu muringo murungi kandi ogutetegyeka, nokukoresa empandiika z'ebigambo ezijwire, okuhindura ebigambo by'emirimo omu muringo oguhikire kurugiirira aha biro, abantu, n'ebigyendererwa by'okuhurirana." Aharuguru y'ekyo, abumba obwomeezi bw'okwega omwana ashemereire kukora orukundo kuruga omu rukurato rw'ebishushani bishatu, ebirikwija kukwatwa omwegyesa. Isabel, ow'emyaka 5, naagamba orukundo orurikukurataho: "Obumwe omu bwire obwahwereireho, hakaba hariho omwojo owaabaire aine llana (ekikere) na pello (embwa) kandi omwojo akagwa omu kitebe kandi llana (ekikere) yaahwa omu kaju kandi yaagenda, kandi akamukwata. Eihwereero." Noorekiremu ebi orikwenda ngu bikorwe omu rurimi orurikworeka omwana w'omutwe ogu, niki ekirikworeka omu rukundo rwa Isabeli ngu atakahikire aha kwega oku?
answer_a: Tarimu kubamu omugano omu bihaguzo omu sentensi ze.
answer_b: Tarimu kubamu adabu omu sentensi ze.
answer_c: Tarikutwara kuhanuura enyito z'ebikorwa ebyahingwire omu bwire obuhikire.
answer_d: Tarikumiza kuruga 'r' omu buringaniza.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya 3 naija kukora n'abegi be aha kuhandiika orubazo, naasinga kwikiriza aha kwihaho aha mbeera y'okuhurirana. Twaba niturora aha kwikiriza kw'omurimo ogu, ekibuuzo ki omwegyesa araakabuze abegi be ekiraabe kirungi munonga kwatandika kutebeekanisiza eby'okuhandiika byabo?
answer_a: Engaito yaituuza kuba nigukwata aha ki?
answer_b: Nitwandiikiira omuhango gwaitu ahabw'oha?
answer_c: Engano ry’omugani gwaitu riza kuba ryabaireho?
answer_d: Nitwija kukoresa orugimi rwa muringo ki omu mbeera yaitu?

question: Kurugiira aha murimo gw'okugezesa, omwegi w'omu mwaka ogw'obushatu akahandiika ebigambo ebi, omu by'ashoboorora ekirikubaho aha mbuto bwanyima y'ebiro mukaaga zimaze kutekwa omu itaka eririirwe. Mei 12. Amahembe g'entaama agariirwe, bwanyima y'ebiro 6, amataagi g'emerire kandi hati nibasha kukora ogw'okukwata omushana gw'izuba. Ni nshonga ki y'ebyaamagambo erikwetenga kurengerezebwa omu bi omwegi ahandiise?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebigyanebyo birikukurata omulingo birikukora
answer_b: Okurikiza omu bwingi n'obukeene aha ndagiriro n'ebara
answer_c: Okukoresa ebigambo by'okukora ebintu omu bwire obutali bumwe
answer_d: Okurikiza omuhendo hagati y'ebizina by'obushoboorozi n'amazina agaabyo bikuruuga omu mwanya.

question: Omugurusi w’omu mwaka ogwa kana ariyo nashomesa ebi abegi be handiika, kurugiirira aha murimo obu yaabahaire okuhandiika orubazo rw’eka. Omwegi akahayo eki: Orubazo rw’Eka Enyakushanju ekaba neizooba riungi. Nkagyenda na mama, na bakuru bange kurya eby’Abachiina. Nkabyenda munonga! Twahika omu resitooraani, tukatwara emeeza y’abantu bana twashaba emenu kureeba ebi turikwenda. Hakaba harimu eby’okurya bibiri, emenu A na B. Tukaata emiriro ya B, ahabw’okuba ekaba erimu eby’okurya bingi. Twamara kucwamu, mama wangye akangira ati, “Martina, ta emiriro.” N’ahabw’ekyo nkayeta omukozi wa resitooraani naata emiriro ya emenu B n’ekinywebwa kya buri omwe ahariitwe. Nkeehurira nk’omukuru! Ni nshoborora ki omwegyesa ashemereire kukosora omu bi handiikirwe by’omwegi?
answer_a: Okuremwa kw'okubanza ekingi ky'ebigambo "menu."
answer_b: Okuhindura ekikwatagaine n'omuntu n'oburyo orugambo "hacer" (kukora) rurimu.
answer_c: Hakaba haroondi ibiri, menu A na B.
answer_d: Okukoresa omuntu omwe omuhandiika omu nshonga: “Ndaashe n’omama wangye na banyinakuru kurya eby’Abachiina.”

question: Omugyezibwa omu, omuhendeki omu omuri ক্লাসিক ya 6 n’abeegi be, n’abegyesa okwetegyereza ebi barikushoma. Nk’ekicweka ky’emirimo, n’abashomesa okushoma ekishairi eki ahabw’ekigyendererwa ky’okukyetegyereza: Ekikurukuru ky’omuyaga, ori murungi munonga, ekikurukuru ky’omuyaga ezaabu na kyatsi. Omushana gw’etaala, ekikurukuru ky’omuyaga guma aho, aho, aho! Guma aho! Kikurukuru, oriho? (Ekikurukuru, Federico García Lorca). Muringo ki gw’okwetegyereza ebi orikushoma ogurikuba gusaana kukoresa bwanyima y’okushoma kugira ngu otungye ekigyendererwa eki orikwenda?
answer_a: Eky'omugasho ky'omutwe gw'ebyakushemererwa omu mutooro nikyo ki?
answer_b: Okuguruukwa kw'ekishuushu, oreeba kireegiire nkahi?
answer_c: Mugambire abanywani banyu abarikushoora aha bishushani by'ebirabyo.
answer_d: Shaza ebyo ebikukwata aha kishushani ky'ekikurukuru omu mutooro kandi obihuunganise n'omushairi.

question: Omugyezibwa w’ekibiina ky’omunaana aryakora n’abegi aha kigyendererwa eki: "Kutebeekanisa okucweekereza kuraba omu kucweekereza obuhame bw’ebirikukoresibwa eby’amanyiso." Okukikora, omurimo nigutebeekanisibwa ogurikugizibwa omu kutorana omuhandiiki ou barikukunda kwega aha murimo gwe, reero bagyenda kworeka omurimo ogwo abegi bagyenzi baabo. Aha mirimo ekurikukurataho, niki ekirikuhiga abegi kukora okushaka amanyiso kuraba omu kutebeekanisa emirimo eyorekwa?
answer_a: Bategyekye kubishomesa ebi barikugyenda kukora, bashange ebyahandiikirwe ebirikuhigaana n'ebyo baraabe bahandiika nk'obu barikumaliriza.
answer_b: Yamba abantu kukora ebishakuzo kurugiirira aha kubuuza ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha bitabo byabo byoona, nk'eky'okureeberaho: omukono gw'omuhandiiki nigweyorekwa guta omu murimo ogu?
answer_c: Shaba omuhanda gw'ebitabo ebyahandiikwa abahandiiki abasheereire, nari, kaba batasheereire, obahereze ekitaabo okurikusiira aha mutindo gw'ebyo bashemereirwe kugira ngu mube n'obwengye obwingi aha nshonga.
answer_d: Teeka okukoresa orutindo rw'ebirikukiririza omu bihandiiko ebirimu, orukuriziire aha bintu nk'ebi: "Kyarugandiikwa omuhandiiko murungi?", "Nikimanyisa omuhandiiki waagwo nari ekitebe ekirikukijunaanira?", "Nikireeta orurimi rw'obuhangaarikiraine aha nshonga?"

question: Omuheereza omu omuhandiiki gw'emyaka 7 omu kicweka ky'ebyeshura, omu mutwe gw'ebyeshura ogurikukwata aha Migani n'Enteekateeka z'Okutonda, omwegyesa naakora aha mugingo gw'okwegyesa ogurikugira guti: "Kwetegyereza omugasho gw'abantu abarikukora omu migani y'okutonda." Kutiisa eki, yaatooraine emigani etooranaine eyahandiikwa ebihangwa ebirukukora. Omu mirimo egi erikukurataho niyo erikukwata aha banyeshura kwetegyereza eki ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Ekyerulo eky'omutaano ekirikugambira aha bantu abakuru abarikukirira omu ngano zoona hamwe n'obuhangwa bwabo.
answer_b: Yombeka ebishushani ebirikworeka abantu abakuru, ab'omubiri n'abato kuruga omu migani ei orikwenda.
answer_c: Taabaaze entebe omurikuumire aha bantu abamwe abarikuruga omu migani ya ira na buri mugani, hamwe n'ebintu byabaire nibashoboorora.
answer_d: Handiika omu bunyabwato obuhango oburikushoborora emitwarize y'abantu abakuru omu migani ei orikwenda.

question: Aha baine kukora omurimo gw'okuhandiika ogurikwenda kumanyisa abeeshuri ab'omu mwaka gwa munaana, omwegyesa akazura ngu abeeshuri abarikukira obwingi baine oburemeezi omu kukoresa ebigambo ebiri kumanyisa ekintu kimwe, ahabw'okuba nibagarukamu ebigambo bimwe n'obutakoresa oburyo obundi nk'amazina agari kubuseraho nari ebiragiro, n'ebindi. Ni muringo ki gw'okubakangura omwegyesa arikubaasa kukoresa oguraahwere abeeshuri kukomeza kukoresa ebigambo ebiri kumanyisa ekintu kimwe omu kuhandiika kwabo?
answer_a: Ongyera obundi ebika by'ebigambo ebirukusobora kukozesebwa kukora ekikwataganyo omu mutwe omuhandiike
answer_b: Ha abeshomesa, mubehemu eky'okwijukya, omwegyesa ogurikugambira aha nshamaishwa, emaziina g'obushobozi, n'ebirikwolekya, hamwe n'eby'okureeberaho by'omukukozesa kwabyo
answer_c: Kora omwegyerano omu, buri omwegi ahabuurura ekyahandiikwa ky'omwegi mugyenzi we, naata omutima aha muringo ogu bakozesezaamu obuhangwa bw'okwegamira hamu.
answer_d: Garuka omuhandiiko ahari buri omwegi orikumworekya ekyorekwa aha buri kigambo ekirikugarukwamu, reero omushabe kukihandiika busya, arikugyira omuhendo gw'ebigambo ebirikumaraho ebyo ebirikugarukwamu, kwonka bikagumizamu birikumanyisa ekintu kimwe.

question: Omuhango gwaha ebitebyo omu omwaka ogw'omunaana, omwegyesa naasoma abegyeswa ekitundutundu ky'ekyevugo eki, kubaasa kwetegyereza omukago oguri ahagati y'ebintu ebirukworekwa n'ebirikukurwa omu kyevugo eki. Alamedas  Eitabi ry'emishanda y'emito ahaiguru   eitabi ririkukurwa, itwe turikukurwa   ahansi y'amababi, itwe turikuguruka   ahaiguru y'omubisi, omutwe gwaheezire.   Amababi nigakukurwa omu mugezi   gw'ekubo. Iza, reero, hurira   oku gurikwibira omu iguru   emikono mirukiriza omu burengyerwa izooba. (Rafael Rubio).  Ekyekuzo ki ahaansi ekirikubaasa kuleetera abegyeswa kukwatanisa ekishushani ekirikukirayo n'amanyiro g'ekyevugo eki?
answer_a: Ni migani ki ey'obwengye ekoresibwe omu mweshongoro ogu?
answer_b: Omuringo gw'okuhandiika eby'ebyeshangizo niguhurirana guta n'omutwe gw'omushairi?
answer_c: Haliho hariho omukago gwona hagati y'ebihuli n'ekirikukora omu mutooro?
answer_d: Omupima gukora gye ki omu kubagabura n'okwetegyereza ekyeshongoro?

question: Omugyezibwa, omu mwaka gwa munaana, aha muheru gw'ekicweka aha mutindo gw'ebishushani, abuuza abeeshuri kukora omuhandiiko mugufu. Ku araabe agyendeire kubashomesa, asanga eki omweeshuri akakora: Enju nk'endijo yoona. Aha buryo bw'obulyo, omwana omu kicweka naazaana aha kompyuta, kandi aha buryo bw'obumoso, taata naatebeekanisiza ecaayi. TAATA: Mwana wangye, ija onywe ecaayi. Eki n'omurundi gwa ikumi ndikukugambira. MWANA: Ndyija, mpa obwire bukye. TAATA: (Naashisha munonga) Ija obu! MWANA: Ego, ndyija, nindaza omupiira gwa Free Fire. Kwonka taata tarikubaasa kwihanganira kandi agyenda naashisha kugamba n'omwana we, kumugambira oku kirikubaasika kuba ayeteenga munonga omuzaano ogu atakikwata obwire na ishe. MWANA: Kwonka taata, n'ahabw'omumaisho gwangye. Ndyaba omuntu orikukwata abantu omu mizaano! -taata agumaho omu kicweka naareeba omwana we naatekateeka-. TAATA: Nkaaba nindikuza kukugaburira obwire bw'okumanya oku turikubaasa kuba hamwe. MWANA: Ayi, ninsaba okusaasira! Mpa obwire bw'emyaka etaano kandi ndyagenda. Kandi oku nikwo eizooba erindi ririkumara omu maka agatarikweraana. Kiki ekirikugumira omu muringo gw'okwega kukora ebihandiiko by'ebishushani ekirikworekwa omu ki omweeshuri akakora?
answer_a: Kutabura ebiragiro by'omugani n'orurimi orukoresibwa omu kweshongora
answer_b: Kutahura eky'ekihisho n'okugamba kw'abantu abarikukora omu muzo.
answer_c: arikusobya eiraka ry'abantu abarikukora omu byafaayo n'eiraka ry'omuhandiiki w'ebyafaayo
answer_d: Tarikumanya omugasho gw'ebirikuragirwa abahereza omu muzano.

question: Omugurusi arikukora aha bishushani by'okuhandiika n'abegi be ab'omwaka gwa 7. Okukora eki, abaha ekihandiiko eki kirimu omugani ogurikukurira: Shoma aha kace kano oteho akashushani k'okuhandiika, obu kirikuba nikihikire, omu kace akatandikirweho omurongo. Sergio Gómez ni omuhandiiki w'ebicweka, omuhweereza, omwegyesa w'orunyayispaani, kandi omuhandiiki wa Chile ou ahemerirwe ahabw'ebitabo by'abato ebi ahandiika, okukira munonga ebitebyo by'omuto orikukora nk'omupangisa Quique Hache. Abegi bahikiiriza omurimo ogu omu muringo oguhikire omu kuteeka akashushani k'okuhandiika omu kace akatandikirweho omurongo bwanyima y'ebigambo: omuhandiiki w'ebicweka na omuhweereza. Ni by'okwegyera ki ebi abegi baine kwetenga okukoresa akashushani k'okuhandiika omu kace akatandikirweho omurongo omu muringo oguhikire?
answer_a: Manya ebintu ebirikushushana omu mbeera y'ebigambo
answer_b: Shobora ebitegyerwa by'ebigambo ebirikushobora amazina.
answer_c: Shobora eirikurirwe omu sentensi.
answer_d: Shisha ebintu ebirikwatanisa omu ndani y'enfumo

question: Omugyezibwa, omu omwegyesa omu class ya munaana, omu bwire bw'ekicweka ky'ebyeshangizo, naija kushwijuma omu muringo ogurikukurira ekigyendererwa eki: "Kwetegyereza emitwarize erikukwata aha muringo gw'ekyeshangizo." question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa 7 okukora okusesa okw’okubanza okugyendererwa kwakwo: okwetegyereza obutabangaaniza omu murimo gw’okushushana. answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebikorwa by'omuntu omukuru n'omuzigu omu kitebe kya'she omuntu ashomire
answer_b: Nibarikira aha kureebeka kw'omuntu mukuru n'omuzigu omu buri kashushani.

question: Omwegyesereza, omwegyesa omu klasse y’omwaka gwa kabiri owa secondary, naija kukora okunoonyereza n’abegi aha bitabo by’Obwire bw’Omuringo, arikwata aha bitegyereiso n’ebyafaayo by’obwo bwire. Bwanyima y’okushaka aha internet, abegi nibaija kukora orutonde lw’ebitabo rurikuru, reero bashooremu ebyahandiikirwe birikukwata aha mugasho gw’okunoonyereza. Omu mirimo egi, niki eki omwegyesa arikuteekateeka ekirikubaasa kuba kirungi munonga ahabw’okushoma ebyahandiikirwe ebi banoonyereize?
answer_a: Omuhanda gw'okukora ebyahandiikwa ebirikukuratira emitindo n'ebirikugambwaho omu byahandiikwa ebyakozirweho, reero oreebe ekirikukorwaho.
answer_b: Shoma omuhanda gw'okubanza ogw'ebyahandiikirwe kushobora ebiteekateeko bikuru, reero ocese amahurro agaagasa omu bushakashatsi.
answer_c: Koresa oburyo bw'okucwamu omutwe n'ekirikukuru omu buri izooba erikukoresibwa, reero otabe amahurizo omu mitwe emito, okurikurugaana n'ekigyendererwa ky'okunoonyereza.
answer_d: Ninkoraaze obuhweerane bw'okukora obucuumu hamwe n'okugyenda omu bucura bw'ebirikukirayo obukuru kuruga omu bitabo ebi orikukoresa, reero okore ebishushani ebirikworeka amakuru aga gakuru munonga ahabw'okushishoza.

question: Omwegyesereza, omuheereza omu mwaka gwa kabiri owa secondary, omu mutwe ogurikukwata aha bihandiiko by'ebyeshongozi kuruga omu bwire bw'Omutaano, ari kukora aha kigyendererwa ekirikugira ngu: "Kwetegyereza ekirikureetera ebyeshongozi ebirukushemeza omu bi shongozi ebirukushushana." Kucweeka eki, nashoma hamwe n'abeeshuri eshongozi eri: Okukunda kutandika n'okutahuumura, okushaba, okugira omutima gw'amaani, n'okutoota; kukura n'oburemeezi, amafumu, n'ebirikwetengwa; kwemereza n'okurira n'okwegayirira. Okutakomaaho n'okuhuumura, nikukuumira okubaaho omu bintu ebirikuhisiriza, okuhitsya n'obusaasi nari obujunaanwa nikuzimya omuriro gwakwo n'amarira gaakwo. Entandikiro yaakwo, hagati yaakwo n'aha muheru wayo nikyo eki: ahabwaki, AlciNo, orikukwatwa obusaasi bw'okuhinduka kwa Celia, ou waakundire? Niki ekirikureetera obusaasi kukugwaho? Ahabw'okuba okukunda tikwakuhisirize, AlciNo wangye, kureka obwire obuhikire bukahiika. (Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz). Abeeshuri abamwe nibagamba ngu tibarikubaasa kwetegyereza ekirikureetera eshongozi egi ahabw'okuba baine ebigambo ebi batazikwetegyereza. Murimo ki omuheereza ashemereire kutebeekanisa abeeshuri kubaasa kwetegyereza ekirikureetera eshongozi egi?
answer_a: Abeshomesha niboore ebigambo ebirikubaasa kuzibira okwetegyereza omushairi, reero baganire aha makuru gaabyo n'abandi baabo.
answer_b: Abeekazi nibaha amakuru agurikubaasa kuba gariyo aha bigambo birikugumira kandi bakagyezaho kugasima nibakozesa obuhabuzi bw'omugurusi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa secondary, omu mwaka ogwa kana, omu mutwe gw'Ebyafaayo eby'Omulembe, ariyo naashoma engyenderwera z'ebyafaayo ezirikukwata aha bitabo by'omulembe. question: Omwegyesereza omugabe w’eisomero ry’ahaiguru, omu kiraasi ekya 1, ari kukora aha kigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Kumanya obuhangwa n’okuhikaana kw’amakanisa kuruga omu nshuro ez’omutaano." answer_a: Ronda omuhendo gw'ebintu ikumi ebirikukwata aha mutwe gumwe, reero obishaanure oreebe ebintu ebiriho ebiri kufaanana omu bwingi bw'ebyo ebi orondire.
answer_b: Shwijuma omu mishomi erimu ebintu by'omutaano aha mutwe gw'enshonga, reero ocerereze ebintu ebi erimu ebirikukwataho n'ekibiina ekirikugishagika.
answer_c: Tebeekanisa enterezya n'omukugu ou barikumanya orikumanyisaana aha mutwe gw'ekiganiiro, obabuze ebibuuzo ebirabugwireho omu kunoonyereza, reero otaashe ebicweka by'okumalirra.
answer_d: Ngyenda kukora okucwekyereza abantu abarikukiriza n'abatarikukiriza okucweera, reero ngyenderere aha bitebyo kurugiirira omu by'ebizoorize.

question: Omu omwegyesa owa secondary omu mwaka gwa 1, ari kukora aha kuhereeza enyehurizo y'ebishobezi omu kuhandiika omu mbeera ezirikukwata aha miteekateeko, narora, omu bindi, okuhikiirira kw'ebikorwa. Omu mbeera egi, omwegi nabuuza ahabw'enki okukoresa ekikoreso kimwe ky'ekikorwa 'haber' nikihaburwa omu sentensi nk'ezi 'Hakaba harimu oburemeezi bwingi omu bunyakwiguru', kandi hatari 'Hakaba harimu oburemeezi bwingi omu bunyakwiguru', yaaba ekirikukurataho kiri omu bwingi: 'oburemeezi bwingi'. Okushoboorora ki kuruga omu mwegyesa okurikubaasa kureka okugarukwamu okurikuhikiire kandi okurikwetegyerezebwa aha kubuusabuusa kw'omwegi?
answer_a: Eihangwe rikuru "Hakaba hariho" nirikumanyisa obuhari bw'ebintu ebirikukorwaho nari embeera, kandi omu mbeera egi, rikoresibwa omu sentensi erimu eky'okukora ekirikukorwa ahabw'ondiijo omuhanda ogurikwetwa periphrastic passive omuri yo ekintu ekirikukorwaho, "omuringo gw'okwegyesa", nikikora nk'ekirikukora ekintu ekirikutwara obwire kuruga aheeru ya sentensi.
answer_b: Ekigambo ky’okukora ekirikugira ngu ‘Hakaba harimu’ tikirikworeka kukwatana kwakyo omu bwingi n’ekicweka ky’omusenteensi ‘ebizibu bingi’, kureka n’‘omuringo gw’okwegyesa’, ekirikukora nk’omutwe gw’omusenteensi ogu, n’ahabw’ekyo ekiragiro ky’obugambirizi ekirikukwata aha mutwe n’ekigambo ky’okukora nikihikiirizibwa.
answer_c: Ekigambo ky'omukozi 'Hakaba harimu' nikikwatanisa n'ekigambo ky'ebara 'ebizibu bingi', ahabw'okuba egi niyo ntwe y'ekigambo ekirikugambwaho. N'ahabw'ekyo, okuba eki kintu kiri bingi tikirikuguza omukozi, ahabw'okuba omu muringo ogu, empinduka y'ekigambo 'kugira' ekora nk'omukozi ogundi ogwataireho.
answer_d: Ekigambo 'Hakaba hariho' nikiraga kubaho kw'ekirikuragwaho bwanyima ya 'ebizibu bingi', ekirikukora nk'ekikuzibwa omu sentensi egi etaine omukuru. Amazima g'okuba kirikworekwa omu bwingi tikirikumanyisa ngu ekigambo kirikuba kiremeese, ahabw'okuba kirikuba kikiragaine n'omukuru, hatariho n'ekikuzibwa.

question: Omugyezibwa w’omu sekenda, omu klasse ey’okuna, ari kukora n’abanyeshuri be aha bikwatiraine n’okuhindurana kw’ebyahandiikwa, kuraba omu kushoma orugano oruhikireho orurikukurataho: Omuhumbuza orareebeka naagwejegyereza amaisho beitu tagwejegyereza. question: Omwebegi w’omwaka ogw’abiri omu secondary, bwamara kukora ekizibu ky’okuhandiika eki abegi bakaba baine kuha ebi barikuteekateeka aha kitabo, akareeba ebi omu aha bo yaahandiika: Ekitabo nikireeta engyenderwaho nzito egi ejugaana aha kubura okwesiga omu bantu abarikukora omu kitabo. answer_c: Orikugira ngu mwebembeso ezirikuruga omu nsi yoona nizireeta obusingye n’okukura omu by’obushoboorozi, kwonka n’obumwe n’obuhangwa bushemereire kureebwa nk’ekintu kikuru.
answer_d: Orikugambirwa omu muringo murungi ebintu birungi eby'okugyenda omu nsi yoona. Kwonka noobaasa ota kuteeraho okushoborora oburemeezi obutari bumwe obu okugyenda omu nsi yoona kureeta aha bantu?

question: Omugyezaho, omu klasse y'omwaka gwa kabiri omu shomero eya wakati, ari kukora aha kigyendererwa eki: "Okukoresa emiringo y'obuhangwa omu buringaniza." Ku yaheire eby'okureeberaho by'emiringo etari emwe na kugarukamu ebibuzo by'abeeshuri, abagambira kuhandiika omutwe muhango murikwenda kugambira omu muringo gw'okugamba omu butahweerera, kurugiirira aha kyakureeberaho eki: Omu kugarukamu omurimo ogu, omu eshuri nagambira omugyezaho: "Nkakyetegyereza oku ndikukora omu muringo gw'okugamba omu butahweerera. Noobaasa kunshoboororera oku ndikukikora?" Ni birikukurataho byona kuruga omugyezaho nibishoboorora omweeshuri omu kuhamya omutwe murikwenda kugambira omu muringo gw'okugamba omu butahweerera?
answer_a: Teekateekateeka omukubagano gw'ebigambo na buli muntu omu omuri katemba, no kubareka kweshoborora. Waamara kugira omukubagano gw'ebigambo murungi, guhandiike.
answer_b: Reeba omu buri muntu omu katambi kandi oteekateeke eky'omugano eky'abo. Reero, ohandiike ebi abantu abo barikuteekateeka omu mugano ogwo.
answer_c:
Buri omwe omu bwiire obwo mumuhe eiziina, ohandiike orubazo oruhango orurikukwata aha bigambo ebirikworeka okutandika, okukoresa obubonero bw'okushoboorora, hamwe n'endengo erikushushana ahabw'omwe omu buri muntu.

**Akatabo k'Ebyafaayo: Omukoro gw'Eky'okugaruka Hamwe**

**Marungi:** Ninteekateeka, "Eki nikyo kiro eki twaba twine kukora ekintu kikuru. Nkaba ngyenda kworeka abantu boona ngu ninyenda kuba omwebembezi murungi." Nkaba ngyenda kutebeekanisa omukoro ogurikwenda kugarura hamwe abantu boona. Nkaba ngyenda kuteera orurembo rw'okugaruka hamwe.

**Kato:** Ninkuratira Marungi, ninteekateeka, "Marungi aine omutima murungi, kwonka obumwe na bumwe akora ebintu bitarikwetegyerezebwa. Ngyenda kumuhwera kutebeekanisa omukoro ogu, kwonka ngyenda kumugambira ebi ndikuteekateeka." Nkaba ngyenda kumuhwera kutebeekanisa omukoro ogu, kwonka nkaba ngyenda kumugambira ebi ndikuteekateeka: ngu twine kutebeekanisa ebintu byona omu muringo murungi.

**Kemirembe:** Nkaba ngyenda kureeba Marungi na Kato nibatebeekanisa omukoro, ninteekateeka, "Nkaba ngyenda kwenda okuhwera, kwonka nkaba ngyenda kureeba obwomeezi bwabo." Nkaba ngyenda kubahwera, kwonka nkaba ngyenda kureeba obwomeezi bwabo: nkaba ngyenda kubahwera kutebeekanisa emmere n'eby'okunywa.

**Rukundo:** Nkaba ngyenda kwija aha mukoro, ninteekateeka, "Nkaba ngyenda kureeba abantu boona, kwonka nkaba ngyenda kureeba obwomeezi bwabo." Nkaba ngyenda kureeba abantu boona, kwonka nkaba ngyenda kureeba obwomeezi bwabo: nkaba ngyenda kureeba obwomeezi bw'abantu boona abarikwenda kugaruka hamwe.

Obwahati, omukoro gukaba gutandikire. Marungi akaba ayemerere ahamaisho g'abantu boona, agamba: "Turi aha kugira omukoro ogurikwenda kugarura hamwe abantu boona. Twine kugaruka hamwe, twine kwendaana, twine kukora hamwe."

Kato akaba amwemerere haihi, amuhwera kutebeekanisa ebintu byona. Kemirembe akaba ariyo arikutebeekanisa emmere n'eby'okunywa. Rukundo akaba ariyo arikureeba abantu boona, arikushaba ngu bagaruke hamwe.

Omukoro gukaba guri ogw'omugisha. Abantu boona bakaba bagarukire hamwe, bakaba bendaana, bakaba bakora hamwe. Marungi akaba ayorekire ngu n'omwebembezi murungi. Kato akaba amuhwereire kutebeekanisa omukoro omu muringo murungi. Kemirembe akaba abahwereire kutebeekanisa emmere n'eby'okunywa. Rukundo akaba ashabaire ngu abantu boona bagaruke hamwe.
answer_d:
**Verbatim Dialogue:**

**Teacher:** Good morning, class. Today, we're going to review fractions. Can anyone tell me what a fraction is?

**Student 1:** It's like, a part of something?

**Teacher:** That's a good start. Can you be more specific?

**Student 2:** It's a number that shows how many parts of a whole you have.

**Teacher:** Excellent! And what are the two parts of a fraction called?

**Student 3:** Numerator and denominator!

**Teacher:** Correct! Now, who can give me an example of a fraction?

**Student 4:** One half!

**Teacher:** Perfect. And what does one half mean?

**Student 4:** It means one part out of two equal parts.

**Teacher:** Exactly! Now, let's try some practice problems.

**Explanatory Dialogue:**

**Teacher:** Good morning, class. Today, we're going to go over fractions again. I want to make sure everyone understands what a fraction actually is. Does anyone remember the basic idea of what a fraction represents?

**Student 1:** I think it's when you have a piece of something, not the whole thing.

**Teacher:** Okay, that's the general idea, but we need a more precise definition. Can anyone add to that?

**Student 2:** A fraction is a way to write a number that shows how much of a whole thing you're talking about. It tells you how many pieces you have compared to how many pieces make up the entire thing.

**Teacher:** Great! That's a good explanation. Now, a fraction has two main numbers. What are those called?

**Student 3:** They're called the numerator and the denominator.

**Teacher:** Exactly! The numerator and denominator. Now, can someone give me an example of a fraction that we use often?

**Student 4:** How about one half, like 1/2?

**Teacher:** Perfect example. Now, what does the fraction "one half" actually tell us? What does it mean in terms of parts and wholes?

**Student 4:** It means you have one piece, and that piece is one of two equal pieces that make up the whole thing.

**Teacher:** Exactly! You've got it. Now that we've reviewed the basics, let's work through some problems to practice using fractions.

question: Omugyezibwa omu owa mwaka gwa kabiri omu aha secondary ari kukorera hamwe n'abeeshuri be aha kushoboorora orurimi rw'emigani. Kwegyendera aha kwega oku, ari kushoma omushairi ogu n'abeeshuri be: KUUHANDIIKA nk'omuntu orikugwa omu nyanja nk'omugwiira nk'omutambuzi nk'omuntu ataine ihanga Kuguma oreebire ekaire aha maani g'eishillingi aha kwesiima aha bwoba Kukunda omwanya ogurikuguruka okukira emyanya ejwire okutiina okukira obuteekateeka okuhinduka okukira oburinzi Eby'emishoro tiburi omwanya oguteireho Eby'emishoro n'omugisha Ekigyere omu misiri ogurikukuratirwa nobamanya ngu tigurikugyenda ahantu hoona. (Jaime Pinos). Ni kiragiro ki ekirikukurataho kuruga omu omugyezibwa orikwebembera abeeshuri omu murimo gw'okushoboorora ogu bashemereire kukora?
answer_a: Ninkubuurira ngu bacuucuure embeera ekyerugiriro eky'omuryoozi ogwo n'emiramwa egirikworeka omushairi, reero omukago oguri hagati y'omuryoozi ogwo ogurikwolekwa.
answer_b: Nimbire kubanza kuta omusitaari aha nshusho z'ebihandiiko eziri omu mutwe gw'ekiganiro, reero bashobore kumanya nshusho ezi zirukukwatana nazo, n'okumanya omuringo murungi gw'okuzishoma.
answer_c: Nimbire kubanza kureeba ebigambo byona ebi bataahuriire omu mutooro, nk'ekigambo "omutengyeereza", "omucwekyererezi", na "omutaineihanga", reero bamanye omukago oguli ahagati yabyo.
answer_d: Nimbire ndaabire batandike kureeba omutwe gw'ekicweka okushobora kumanya ekirikukwataho, reero batandike kukwatanisa ebigambo by'omutaano ebirikushoborora ensonga, amakuru g'ebyo ebigambo birikumanyisa, hamu n'enyegyesereza ebi birikureeta.

question: Omugurusi, omu mwaka gwa 1, ari kukorera hamwe n'abegi be aha mutindo gw'okushoma ogw'okucuumuura. Kandi arikukora eki, naakoresa omuringo gw'okubuuza ebibuuzo aha kacweka k'omugani aka, arikubuuza ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha mutindo gw'okucuumuura: Tukaba nitukunda kusaaga omu rubungo. Tukaba nitugyenda enyena. Laucha akaba "naabarikwata" omutima. Akaba naabarikwenda omu muringo gw'ekizunga kandi yaabateeka ahansi. N'akakondo akatono, akaba naashushaniisa ekikari kyabo. Buri kimwe kikaba kiri eky'amaheere. Omusozi oguri hare. Eihuriro ry'omuyaga. Kandi maama wangye omu idirisa akaba naatureeba nitukura. Omwezi gwa Sande gumwe, embwa embi ekatwara taata wangye okuturugaaho. Maama wangye akafiira omu magara. "Agendere, mwana wangye," omwishiki omuto akagira, "yegyendereze maama waawe." Nkakura bwangu ndi omu myaka ikumi na ebiri. Okuhitsya obu nkahika Santiago, nkaba ntarikumanya ngu tukaba turi aboro. (Obuto, Pablo Ortiz Tirado. Santiago omu Magambo Kikumi). Eky'aha bibuuzo ebi ekirikukwata aha mutindo gw'okucuumuura omu mugani?
answer_a: Ahabw'enki omuntu omukuru omu byafaayo arikugamba ngu akakula omu kasumi katari kamara?
answer_b: Ni bintu ki ebiri omu mulingo oguhuza omuntu omukuru omu mulingo n'obuto bwe?
answer_c: Waakubaasa oteekateeka ngu okabaasa kwehurira ori omworo, nk'omuntu mukuru omu muko, ku orikwimuka omu byaro omu kuza omu orubuga? Ahabwaki?
answer_d: Laucha akakozesa muringo ki kuhuunya enkoko?

question: Omwegyesereza, omwegyesi omu omwaka gwa 3 ogw’ahaiguru, ari kukora n’abegyi be aha bigyendererwa ebi: "Kumanya emiringo y’okubazaana". Kandi arikukora eki, nashoboorora emitwarize ya buri muringo, reero areeta eby’okureeberaho bimwe kandi aha abegyi obuhabuzi bw’okumanya emiringo omubice bimwe. Ekice kimwe omu muringo ogurikwetwa ogw’obuteeteerera nikyo eki: "Charles akataangwa obweru bw’enjara ze. Zikaba zirangaazi, zityaire aha ntumbe, ziri kurungi kusinga amahembe g’enzovu ga Dieppe, kandi ziri nk’obusheija. Kwonka omukono gukaba gutarikurungi, ahakuba gukaba gutarikweru gwaahika, kandi guri nk’engyezi omu bigere; gukaba kandi mureezi munonga kandi gutaine obutoosha bw’emishorongo aha mbibo. Ekikaba kirungi n’amaisho; n’obu gukaba guri gwa buruuru, gukaba nigareebeka gwa iraaka ahabw’ebirebyo, kandi okureeba kwe kukaza n’obwesigwa n’obumanzi oburikukara". (Madame Bovary, Gustave Flaubert). Omwe aha begi naagarukamu ngu ekice kirimu omuringo oguteteeraine ahabw’okuba harimu omubazi owa kashatu. Twahirira aha kugarukamu oku, niki eki omwegyesi ashemereire kureetera abegyi kumanya aha miringo y’okubazaana, abegyi baaze kumanya omuringo ogurikwetwa ogw’obuteeteerera?
answer_a: Kwetegyereza omuhanda ogurikukoresibwa omu kuhandiika eby'omugani
answer_b: Kumanya emiringo y'abarikugamba omu mbeera omu mucwezi
answer_c: Ebirikumanyisa enjara y'omuhandiiki n'eriyo abantu abarikukora omu mulingo omuhandiiki arikugamba omu mulingo gwabo omu nganooni
answer_d: Okumanya omuntu orikugamba eby'omugani arikumira ataana ki n'eby'omugani ogwo

question: Omwegyesereza omugambwa, omuheereza omu ishomero omu kika kya 4, naija kushuuruura ekigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza emitwarize y'ekigambo ekikuru, omu mbeera y'okushoboorora eby'omuziki eby'ekyasha kya 20". Ni kiragiro ki ekirikukurataho ekirikushobora ekigyendererwa ekirikushuuruurwa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebigambo by'okuhabura ebirikumanyisa omugani.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza amakuru g'ekishushani ky'ebyahandiikwa ekirikukurira amakuru agahisire g'ekigambo ky'obwengye.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza amakuru g'obushabure g'ekyevugo n'amazima eki kigyenda kworeka.
answer_d: Nibamanya kumanya omulingo gw'okwegendereza ogw'ekigambo ekikuru kuraba omu mwanya gwakyo ahaiguru y'ekintu ekihandiikirwe.

question: Omwegyesereza, omuheereza omu iraaya ry'aha Rwagati orw'omwaka gwa 3, naija kushomesa, okuraba omu kashomesho akahandiikirwe, ekigyendererwa eki: "Kwetegyereza omugasho gw'abantu abarikukora omu mpaka z'omugani, kurugiirira aha kushoma omugani." Ni birikukurataho byona ebiraakuratira aha kutuunga okwega okurikushomesibwa?
answer_a: Nibarikira emiringo y’enkoragana eri hagati y’abantu abarikukora omu byafaayo n’okuza kwabo arikukwata aha byafaayo.
answer_b: Nibarikira aha miringo abantu abakuru omu muringo ogu barikwetwaraamu omu mwanya gwona ogw'omugani hamwe n'oku egi miringo erikureetera enkomerero y'omugani ogwo.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omu biteekateeko by’abantu abarikukwatwaho omu muringo ogu barikugambirwamu n’oku ebyo birikukwata aha ku orugano rurikukura.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza buri muntu omu mwanya ogu arikukorera, okurikugyenderera aha bukuru bwabo omu mbeera, niboreka oku barikucwamu okukura kw'ebintu ebirikubaho.

question: Omwegyesereza omu, omwegyesi omu omwaka gwa 1 omuishomero erikuru arikushaba abegi be kukora ekihandiiko aha mutwe gwona ogu barikwenda. Omu muringo gw'okucweekereza, omwegyesi arikuhereza ekihandiiko eki kuruga omuri omwe aha begi: Nikikuru kwegyendesereza obutonde, munonga hati obu turi omu bwire obugumire obu ekintu ekikuru munonga, nk'oku abahanga ba sayansi barikugamba, n'okuba nitutuuraho omu kasumi akatazooka, obu enshiko etaine obwire burikumara okugarura eby'omugasho ebi twamara. Tikirikukwama okuzimya etabaaza aha saaha emwe nari kureka kuta obucuucu omu maizi, nk'oku kirikumanywa ngu kampani niniizo nizo ezirimu omulingo murungi kandi ogutahwaho ogw'okwonoona. Ekitabo ekyahandiikirwe ekyahwaireho eky'ekibiina kya UN, ekyarugire omu kwezi kwa August omwaka ogu, nikigamba kandi nikihamya eki: hatariho enkyukira nini, enkyukira ntono tizirikukwama. N'ahabw'ekyo, nikikuru kwegyendesereza obutonde omu mulingo murungi, kuruga aha nini kuhika aha nto. Ebiro ebi nibyo by'omugasho. Omulingo ki gw'amateeka g'okuhandiika ogurikukwama omwegyesi kugambira omwegi orikukora ekihandiiko eki?
answer_a: Okuteeka obubonero obw'okwongyeramu amakuru aha nyukuta
answer_b: Okuhandiika ebigambo ebirikushushana omu mazina kwonka bitarikushushana omu bumanzi.
answer_c: Okuhandiika ebigambo ebiri haihi n'okushushana
answer_d: Amateeka agakurabura ag'okuteeka akareebyo

question: Ni eni aha mirundi egi erikukuraho, erikukura okwetegyereza amakuru g'ebigambo, kandi ahabwaki?
answer_a: Kuhanga sentensi n'okukurikirana ebintu omu bwire ahabw'okuba nibikwasa omu kutebeekanisa ebigambo
answer_b: Kukora omuringo gw'okuta omu biceera n'okushushaanisa ebigambo ahabw'okuba nibikuruha amakuru omu bigambo.
answer_c: Okugyezamu eby'okuhikaana n'okugaburamu ebigambo omubucweka bwabyo ahabw'okuba nibikwasisa kumanya amagambo agari omu bigambo.
answer_d: Kukora emizaano y'ebiro by'ekikorwa n'okushoborora abantu ahabw'okuba nibikwemerera kutebeekanisa ebigambo

question: Ni eni aha mirundi egi erikukuriza omuntu kwega amagezi g'okukoresa orurimi omu mbeera ez'omubuzima?
answer_a: Shangwa omu bwebeshereezi bw'ebigambo omu nshomo ezigufu
answer_b: Hanga enyegyeso z'ebigambo noroora ebifaananyi by'ebigambo
answer_c: Kucumura ebirikumanyisa omu bigambo by'ebishakuzo by'ekirahiro ebitari bimwe
answer_d: Teeka omushoboorozi orikukiraho omuhanda ogurikushoboorora ekigambo omu muringo ogutari ogwo ogurateebeekanisiibwe.
